name: Disable Sales for WooCommerce
author: michaltry

sections.description:
Going on holiday, doing a stock-take or moving warehouses? Disable Sales for WooCommerce closes the shop for the period you choose and opens it again by itself.

  • Pick a first and a last closed day; both are included, the shop reopens the day after.
  • Repeat the same period every year (also across New Year, e.g. 20 December to 6 January).
  • While closed, no product can be added to the cart and existing carts cannot be checked out.
  • Customers see a WooCommerce-style notice on the cart and checkout – or on every page, if you want.
  • Write your own notice text, with [date_from] and [date_to] for the dates.
  • Works with the classic cart and checkout and with the cart and checkout blocks; compatible with high-performance order storage (HPOS).
  • Dates use your shop’s timezone and date format.

Settings: WooCommerce → Settings → Disable Sales.

This plugin is maintained by Regelkit, makers of EU compliance plugins for WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. Install from the WordPress plugin directory or upload wc-disable-sales to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Disable Sales, enable the plugin and set the dates.
sections.faq:
Is the “until” date included?

Yes. If you close the shop until 15 August, customers can buy again on 16 August at midnight (shop timezone).

What do customers see?

Products show as not purchasable (no add-to-cart button), and the cart and checkout show a notice with your dates. With “Always show notice” the notice appears on every page of the shop.

Does it work with the cart and checkout blocks?

Yes. With the block-based cart and checkout the closed shop is reported as a cart error, which prevents checkout.

Can I repeat the closure every year?

Yes, tick “Repeat”. The same days are used every year, including periods that cross New Year.

Are existing orders affected?

No. Only new purchases are blocked; orders, subscriptions and the admin area work as usual.

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2; declares compatibility with HPOS and the cart/checkout blocks.
  • Block cart and checkout: the closed shop is reported as a cart error.
  • Fixed: the notice was not shown on the classic cart and checkout.
  • The “until” date is now included (the shop reopens the day after); dates use the shop’s timezone and date format.
